slides.title: Find your *real* skin type in 30 minutes
slides.sub: No products, no quiz. Just your bare face and a clock.
slides.kicker: COMMENT YOUR RESULT AT THE END

slides.title: Wash, pat dry, apply nothing
slides.body: Use a gentle cleanser. No toner, no serum, no moisturizer. You want your skin *as it is*.
slides.fix: Do it in the morning, before makeup or SPF.

slides.title: Now wait
slides.body: Give your skin 30 minutes to settle. Don't touch your face.
slides.fix: Then look closely in daylight, by a window.

slides.title: Shiny all over
slides.body: Forehead, nose, chin *and* cheeks look glossy, and pores look bigger.
slides.fix: You're likely *oily*. Light gel moisturizer, don't skip it.

slides.title: Tight, dull or flaky
slides.body: Skin feels like it needs moisturizer right now. Maybe a few rough patches.
slides.fix: You're likely *dry*. Creamy cleanser, richer moisturizer.

slides.title: Shiny T-zone, normal cheeks
slides.body: Forehead and nose catch the light. Cheeks feel comfortable or a little dry.

slides.title: Comfortable, barely any shine
slides.body: No tightness, no grease. Lucky you.
slides.fix: You're likely *normal*. Keep it simple and protect it with SPF.

slides.title: Stings or turns red easily?
slides.body: Sensitivity isn't a type of its own. It sits *on top* of any of the four, so add it to your result.
slides.fix: Fewer actives, patch test everything new.

slides.title: Want the *full* picture?
slides.body: Glowi's 3-angle scan builds your skin profile in seconds: score, concerns and a routine.
